name: Contil India Limited
about: Contil India Limited engages in the sourcing, processing, packaging, and export/trading of food and grocery products in India. The company offers spices, cereals and pulses, namkeen and snacks, papad, edible oils, beauty and cosmetics, Ayurvedic items, and household articles/utensils under the CONTIL, Contil from the Earth, and Gujjus brand names. It also exports its products, including Canada and the United States. The company was formerly known as Continental Credit & Investments Ltd. and changed its name to Contil India Limited in December 2007. Contil India Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Vadodara, India.
